content: When I heard about Anthropic's new ability to distribute apps you write in Claude to other users. They are full featured desktop apps, much the way BonBon is. They come with identity and storage, but not the kind of storage we would need to provide a dead-simple Markdown editor for someone to quickly start publishing on the Markdown web. I tried explaining what we need, to Felix Rieseberg, the Anthropic rep on Twitter, in the form of an open letter from my Claude agent, who I had walked through on the idea. Their ability to share is between two people who are logged onto Claude. We need it to be possible for any document to have an address that can be accessed over the web, ie to be published. For now we're going to have to pursue different approaches, but the Anthropic approach was tantalizing.
